fullPassage: If you suffer from social angst, awkwardness, or dread, know that this is a perfectly normal response. No matter what it looks like, a lot of people are dealing with internal anxiety in social situations. But it is actually possible to build your social muscle and use it to boost your connections — and your anxiety is giving you clues to what icebreakers and lifelines other people might be grateful for you to extend. Truly listen to what your anxiety is signaling to you about where you feel uncertain or insecure, and practice empathy by offering a hand to others who might be in the same boat. Remember that flipping anxiety into compassion is something inherent in you — it is, in fact, what your anxiety was designed to do for you. Together, compassion and empathy can buffer against bad anxiety. You can use your anxiety to be more outward-facing. The outcome? The spread of compassion for your fellow human beings, other species, and the planet!

det.tip: 동명사 주어: Flipping anxiety into compassion is something...

questions.passage: If you suffer from social angst, awkwardness, or dread, know that this is a perfectly normal response. No matter what it looks like, a lot of people are dealing with internal anxiety in social situations. But it is actually possible to build your social muscle and use it to boost your connections — and your anxiety is giving you clues to what icebreakers and lifelines other people might be grateful for you to extend. Truly listen to what your anxiety is signaling to you about where you feel uncertain or insecure, and practice empathy by offering a hand to others who might be __________. Remember that flipping anxiety into compassion is something inherent in you — it is, in fact, what your anxiety was designed to do for you. Together, compassion and empathy can buffer against bad anxiety. You can use your anxiety to be more outward-facing. The outcome? The spread of compassion for your fellow human beings, other species, and the planet!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ①다른 차원(in a different league) ②반대편(on the opposite side) ③같은 처지(in the same boat) ④세상 정상(at the top of the world)
det.analysis:
① in a different league: 다른 수준이라는 의미로 문맥 부적합.

② on the opposite side: 반대편은 같이 겪는다는 문맥과 모순.

③ in the same boat ←정답: 같은 처지에 있을 수 있는 다른 사람들에게 손을 내밀라는 문맥에 적합.

④ at the top of the world: 세상 정상은 불안 상황과 맞지 않음.
